definitions.explanation: Upper front teeth that stick out forward. A plain, rather blunt word; dentists say {上顎前突|じょうがくぜんとつ}, and people often soften it when talking about someone else.

examples.japanese: {出|で}っ{歯|ぱ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{治|なお}す→治す：19371_naosu⟧。
{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：32850_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{出|で}っ{歯|ぱ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にしていた→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧。
examples.english: As a child, I was self-conscious about my buck teeth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{矯正|きょうせい}→矯正：14784_kyousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、{出|で}っ{歯|ぱ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧⟦{目立|めだ}たなく→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to orthodontic treatment, my buck teeth are hardly noticeable anymore.

notes:
From ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to stick out) and ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧ (teeth); the ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ becomes ぱ after the small っ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出|で}っ{歯|ぱ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にする→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧: to be self-conscious about one's buck teeth
- {出|で}っ{歯|ぱ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{矯正|きょうせい}→矯正：14784_kyousei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to straighten buck teeth with braces

WATCH OUT:
Calling someone {出|で}っ{歯|ぱ} to their face is rude, like calling them "bucktoothed". About oneself it is fine.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{八重歯|やえば}→八重歯：32477_yaeba⟧: a protruding canine (once considered cute in Japan)
- ⟦{歯並|はなら}び→歯並び：32305_hanarabi⟧: the alignment of one's teeth
